title: Three Weeks and One Short Bandage
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：tablet　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tablet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the doctor ① took the tablet that no patient in the clinic would have described, and he said the taking was the whole of the week. The ② tablet, meaning the device itself and not the bandage, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a tablet, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ tablet in that clinic had the same short bandage beside it, and the ④ tablet at the far bed, meaning the scar they kept for the children to cover and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tablet, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the doctor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tablet was the whole of the matter, meaning the dose and not the device. The ⑥ tablet, meaning the dose and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tablet, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a device and a dose. He said the dose is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ tablet had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bandage. The ⑧ tablet of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one clinic and three weeks of describing; tablet, he said, is either the scar at the far bed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tablet I remember is the device described in the chart, which closed in 2001 and is still described as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ tablet, my mother said in 2003, is the only device that improves by being described; every tablet, she said, is a dose that has agreed to look like a device. She said the dose was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 药片；平板电脑（指卫生所里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 药片；平板电脑（指那片药片本身，与窄窄的绷带相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the tablet 服这一片药片
D. n. 药片；平板电脑（指留给孩子们遮着的那一道）
E. n. 药片之事（抽象总称，指一处卫生所的药片之事）
F. n. 药片；平板电脑（指病历里写到、被描述的那一片）
G. n. 药片、剂量（指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 剂量（抽象总称，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the tablet that no patient in the clinic would have described
The tablet, meaning the device itself and not the bandage
the tablet at the far bed
the tablet was the whole of the matter
the tablet had become a line in a chart
The tablet of the whole thing
A tablet, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: take the tablet 意为“服这一片药片”，1994 年那位大夫把卫生所里没有一位病人肯描述的一片药片做了一遍。
tablet 意为“药片；平板电脑”，指那片药片本身而不是窄窄的绷带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
tablet 意为“药片；平板电脑”，指卫生所里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。
tablet 意为“药片；平板电脑”，指最远那张床边的留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tablet 意为“药片、剂量”，指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片剂量就是那件事的全部。
tablet 意为“剂量”，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片药片，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tablet 意为“药片；平板电脑”，指病历里写到、被描述的那一片，到 1999 年这一片成了病历里的一行。
tablet 意为“药片之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的药片之事是一处卫生所和三个星期的描述。
tablet 意为“药片；平板电脑”，我记得的是病历里描述过的那一片，2001 年养好了，至今仍被说成卫生所里最安静的一片。
tablet 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，药片是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的药片。
